fusions.name: Darkened Sky
fusions.desc: Blots out the sky over every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stripping Bite
fusions.desc: A stripping bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Plague Year
fusions.desc: Calls a second cloud that fights for 15 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Grows as It Feeds
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
